name: Anchor Viking Restaurant & Fresh Fish
address: 23 Bland St, Mossel Bay, 6500, South Africa
description_short: Family-run seafood spot in Mossel Bay serving fresh line fish and Viking-inspired dishes since generations.
description_long:
Tucked along Bland Street in the heart of Mossel Bay, Anchor Viking has been a local institution for fresh seafood and hearty meals. The restaurant blends South African coastal flavours with a nod to Viking heritage, creating a relaxed, family-friendly atmosphere where locals and visitors gather over generous portions of line fish, calamari, and grills.

The menu centres on what's fresh that day — expect beautifully prepared hake, yellowtail, and prawns alongside burgers and steaks for those who prefer turf to surf. The portions are honest, the prices fair, and the service unpretentious. It's the kind of place where you can bring the kids after a day at the beach or settle in for a laid-back lunch with ocean-fresh flavours.

Located close to the Mossel Bay harbour and town centre, it's an easy stop whether you're exploring the Garden Route or calling Mossel Bay home. No frills, just good food and a welcoming vibe that keeps people coming back.
